newsitem.title: USA: MEDIQ, Universal Hospital extend merger pact.
newsitem.headline: MEDIQ, Universal Hospital extend merger pact.

text.p: MEDIQ Inc and Universal Hospital Services Inc said Thursday they have extended their merger agreement to have more time to address concerns raised by the Federal Trade Commission.
The date after which either company could terminate the agreement has been extended to October 31 from August 30, the companies said.

The companies also amended the agreement to include a termination right under which either party could end the merger within five business days if a federal district court were to issue a preliminary inunction preventing the deal from taking place.
On April 10, the FTC sought more information about MEDIQ's plan to acquire Universal for $17.50 per share. The total value of the deal is about $138 million, including assumption of debt.

"MEDIQ and UHS are disappointed that the government review has gone so slowly, although we are continuing to work with the staff of the FTC," Universal President and Chief Executive Thomas Minner said in a statement.
